button_key.note: Shows its key by name, captures the next key or mouse button when pressed and sends it as Luanti 5.17's SYSTEM_SCANCODE_ or MOUSE_BUTTON_ string, with Escape cancelling. Only keys in its table (letters, digits, punctuation, function, editing, arrow, keypad and modifier keys) are captured; gamepad buttons and axes are not, and key names are English.

field_enter_after_edit.note: Parsed and ignored, which is the whole behaviour on a non-Android client.

hypertip.note: Drawn by the form as upstream draws it: the markup rendered at the given width in ems of the form's text, at the static position when one is given, with bgcolor, border and bgimg from style[] on its name.

hypertext.note: Tags, styles, images, items, actions with their hovercolor, and the <global> page settings (margin, halign, valign, background) are rendered; images and items do not float, and items are not rotated (angle, rotate).

model.note: The mesh is loaded with Luanti's own loaders, textured, posed at the frame loop and drawn in a SubViewport, honouring the initial rotation, continuous rotation, mouse control, a non-zero animation speed and style[] bgcolor. A mesh whose media has not arrived falls back to a labelled placeholder, where upstream draws nothing.

scrollbaroptions.note: min, max, smallstep, largestep and thumbsize are applied. Godot's scrollbar draws no arrow buttons, so the arrows option has nothing to act on.

style.note: Resolved and applied as upstream does, states and deprecated per-state properties included: colours and tints, background and foreground images, borders, padding, content_offset, font and font_size, sound, list slot geometry, a model's bgcolor, a hypertip's look, and the halign and valign of formspec version 11 on area labels, fields and read-only textareas. Not applied: noclip (Goanna never clips an element to the form, so what upstream would cut off is still drawn), alpha, and halign and valign on an editable textarea, which Godot's TextEdit cannot align. Fonts are the system's, not Luanti's Arimo and Cousine.

style_type.note: As style: everything but noclip, alpha, and halign and valign on an editable textarea is applied, with the system's fonts in place of Luanti's.

tablecolumns.note: text, image, color, indent and tree columns with align, width and tooltip; the padding option is ignored.

tooltip.note: Drawn by the form as GUIFormSpecMenu draws it: named and area tooltips in their own colours or the listcolors[] defaults, colour escapes kept, element tooltips after tooltip_show_delay's default of 400 ms.
